config.purpose: document committed benchmark rules; no experiment executed

evaluation.family_confidence: 1 - 0.05/(9 * (K + 2)); K is the number of complete API dice cohorts
evaluation.family_bootstrap_note: At least 100 expected resamples per corrected tail; descriptive marginal CIs retain 10000 resamples.
evaluation.api_interval_separation: Require both expected-PnL and percentage-of-Bayes marginal 95% intervals to separate, plus positive corrected paired differences.

inference_group_sensitivity.group_size: Read the frozen local cohort provenance config.eval_batch_size; serial cohorts use 1.
inference_group_sensitivity.resampling: Sorted episode seeds, non-overlapping complete inference groups; resample group means with common indices for local/reference/API comparisons.
inference_group_sensitivity.decision_rule: Require positive primary and inference-group family lower bounds for cards and paired API superiority. No choice between methods after seeing scores.
inference_group_sensitivity.scope: Conditional on frozen weights and recorded response cache; does not estimate fresh-cache or training-seed variation.

evaluation.local_validation_contrast_family: Eighteen contrasts: six follow-ups versus SFT in both games, plus RLOO96 versus RLOO24, RLOO192 versus RLOO96, and RLOO384 versus RLOO192 in both games; Bonferroni 1-0.05/18, 72000 resamples, seed 0. RLOO384 registered after RLOO192 validation, before its own validation. Earlier six- and fourteen-contrast receipts retained; one selected local test candidate, nine final candidates total.
evaluation.newest_family_selection: Round 3: validate saved SFT and GRPO96 adapters serially on 100/game, freeze max min(dice percent -80, cards percent), SFT wins ties, then evaluate only that winner on 200/game. Both local and newest-family decisions precede opening any new aggregate held-out score. The unselected newest-family slot remains counted in the conservative nine-candidate family.

training.dagger_last_rule: Last numbered saved DAgger checkpoint; evaluate on 100 validation episodes per game before freezing the one local test candidate. Keep teacher-loss-selected checkpoint as a separate validation trial.

amendments.reason: Before new final scores: count all four frozen candidates and improve Monte Carlo precision of corrected tails.
Conservatively clarify interval separation in both displayed score scales before inspecting any new aggregate held-out score; no training or selection change.
Before any new aggregate held-out score: register separate staged CUDA warm-start and GRPO candidates, keeping both original candidates counted; use explicit trainer/data seeds 0.
Before newest-family training or final evaluation: count Qwen3.8 SFT and GRPO final candidates conservatively, following successful two-T4 fit probe. No policy test scores used.
Before any new held-out aggregate score: freeze a two-adapter game routing baseline using completed validation only; count an additional final candidate conservatively.

Before new held-out aggregate inspection: a training-state serial/batch quote mismatch motivates whole-inference-group bootstrap sensitivity. Require both primary and sensitivity positivity; retain nine candidates.

DAgger teacher validation at 199/399 is worse than the initial SFT adapter; testing only its teacher-selected checkpoint may therefore test unchanged weights. Register the fixed last saved training checkpoint as another validation trial before any DAgger/RLOO policy validation or held-out aggregate. No held-out candidate added: one local validation winner remains. Widen the validation contrast family from four to six before any follow-up contrast is observed.

RLOO24 improves dice validation but remains below target. Before any local selection/test, register fixed 96/192-group continuations with unchanged seed/reward/decoder/lr and widen validation contrasts to fourteen. Preserve earlier six-contrast results. One selected local test candidate remains; nine final candidates total.
Owner-authorized round-3 saved-batch 27B rerun, replacing the lost interactive draft; no new held-out aggregate inspected.

newest_family_selection.rule: max min(dice percent of Bayes - 80, cards percent of Bayes); SFT wins ties
newest_family_selection.test_policy: Freeze adapter hash after validation, then evaluate only the selected newest-family candidate once, missing-only on interruption. Keep the other checkpoint validation result; do not inspect an unselected held-out score.
newest_family_selection.reason_for_serial_inference: Earlier 4B diagnostics demonstrated batch-composition-dependent quotes; serial inference avoids that uncertainty for the new primary experiment.
newest_family_selection.all_new_test_aggregates: Remain sealed until local and newest-family selections are frozen.

amendments.reason: Record the already registered final local doubling and the Round 3 saved-batch selection/sealing controls in the canonical protocol. RLOO384 training is active; its validation and all new held-out aggregation remain pending.
